subject: Hardwick Health pilot: acceptance checklist + sprint milestones
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Grant <emily.grant@hardwickhealth.org>, Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@hardwickhealth.org>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Hardwick Health pilot: acceptance checklist + sprint milestones

Hi Emily / Tom —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the pilot scoped and scheduled. I attached a lightweight acceptance checklist and a one-page sprint roadmap (attached).

High-level success criteria (please confirm or edit):
- Model quality: generated summaries must meet >= 85% relevance score vs. your internal eval rubric across the 100-case sanity set.
- Latency: 95th percentile generation latency under 600ms for median token length (300 tokens) during 10rps sustained load.
- Data handling: no PHI leaves your VPC; Redwood Private deployment or dedicated instance with customer-managed KMS.
- Operational: weekly check-ins, one final readout with runbook and export of logs.

Proposed timeline (2-week sprint cadence):
1) Week 0 (kickoff) — project intro, access handoff, success criteria sign-off.
2) Week 1 — ingest sample dataset, baseline eval, early latency tuning.
3) Week 2 — iterative prompts, quantization/checkpoint test, run final eval set.
4) Final readout (end of week 2) — results, recommendations, next-phase options.

Owners (suggested):
- Redwood: Hannah (project lead), Vivek (integration / infra), Alex (SRE & latency tuning)
- Hardwick: Emily (product), Tom (engineering lead)

Immediate asks for kickoff:
- Hardwick to confirm acceptance criteria above (or mark changes) by Fri 2026-09-17.
- Provide a scoped sample dataset (s3 link or shared Drive) and an account/service user with limited read-only access for ingestion.
- Indicate whether you prefer Redwood Private (VPC) or Dedicated reserved capacity for the pilot.

Proposed kickoff window: Mon 2026-09-20 or Tue 2026-09-21 — pick preferred day and time and we’ll lock it.

Attachments: POC-Acceptance-Checklist.xlsx, Pilot-Sprint-Roadmap.pdf

Thanks —
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: Emily Grant <emily.grant@hardwickhealth.org>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@hardwickhealth.org>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 13:47:22 -0700
Subject: Re: Hardwick Health pilot: acceptance checklist + sprint milestones

Thanks Hannah — this is very helpful. A few quick notes and questions: 

1) Acceptance criteria: overall these look right. Two edits: change relevance score threshold to 80% for the first run (we'll be conservative) and add a false-positive cap of <= 2% on PHI tagger.
2) Data access: we can share a restricted S3 bucket and create an IAM role with read-only access. Will that be sufficient?
3) Security: we need a short security questionnaire and evidence of SOC 2 status before data access. Who should I send that to?

Can we kickoff Mon 2026-09-20 at 10:00am PT if that works for you and your team?

Emily
Emily Grant
Senior Product Manager, Hardwick Health
emily.grant@hardwickhealth.org

From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>

Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hardwick Health pilot: acceptance checklist + sprint milestones

Emily / team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the S3 approach sounds perfect. A couple of technical clarifications so we don't block kickoff on Monday: 

- Data format: CSV or newline-delimited JSON is best. Please include a small schema file for field mapping.
- IAM role: please create an IAM role with a policy scoped to only the sample bucket and attacha one-time external ID for audit. We will use a temporary ingestion credential and rotate it after the pilot.
- PHI tagging: we'll run your data through our tagger in your VPC (or dedicated instance) and provide the false-positive report. For the 2% cap Emily requested, we will show initial false-positive numbers and a mitigation plan if it’s trending up.

Attachment: ingest-checklist.md (small checklist for engineers).

Vivek / Alex action items (internal):
- Vivek: prep VPC deployment template and KMS handshake notes pre-kickoff.
- Alex: pre-load baseline model and run a dry-latency test with a small synthetic corpus on Thursday 2026-09-17.

Hannah — please confirm kickoff time tomorrow at 10:00am PT if that still works.

Cheers,
Alex
Alex Martinez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
alex_martinez@redwood.ai

Great — kickoff confirmed for Mon 2026-09-20 at 10:00am PT. I've updated the acceptance checklist to reflect the 80% initial relevance threshold and the <=2% PHI false-positive cap. Updated files are in the shared Drive (link below).

Quick operational notes for the kickoff meeting:
- Agenda: introductions, security handoff (SOC2 intake), ingestion plan and roles, baseline eval plan, expected timelines and reporting cadence.
- Weekly cadence: 30-minute standups every Wednesday at 10:00am PT (first one Wed 2026-09-22).
- Reporting: we'll publish a short readout doc in Drive at the end of Week 2 and share a follow-up with runbook and logs export.

Owners (confirmed):
- Redwood: Hannah (PM contact), Alex (latency & infra), Vivek (deployment & ingestion), Marissa (success metrics & readout)
- Hardwick: Emily (product), Tom (eng)

Security contact: please send the SOC2 questionnaire and any compliance artifacts to security@redwood.ai — our security team will respond within 24 business hours.
